title: Noise-Aware and Dynamically Adaptive Federated Defense Framework for SAR Image Target Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2601.00900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As a critical application of computational intelligence in remote sensing, deep learning-based synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image target recognition facilitates intelligent perception but typically relies on centralized training, where multi-source SAR data are uploaded to a single server, raising privacy and security concerns. Federated learning (FL) provides an emerging computational intelligence paradigm for SAR image target recognition, enabling cross-site collaboration while preserving local data privacy. However, FL confronts critical security risks, where malicious clients can exploit SAR's multiplicative speckle noise to conceal backdoor triggers, severely challenging the robustness of the computational intelligence model. translated_title: 面向SAR图像目标识别的噪声感知与动态自适应联邦防御框架
translated_abstract: 作为计算智能在遥感领域的关键应用，基于深度学习的合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像目标识别促进了智能感知的发展，但其通常依赖于集中式训练，即需要将多源SAR数据上传至单一服务器，这引发了隐私与安全方面的担忧。联邦学习（FL）为SAR图像目标识别提供了一种新兴的计算智能范式，能够在保护本地数据隐私的同时实现跨站点协作。然而，联邦学习面临着关键的安全风险：恶意客户端可以利用SAR的乘性散斑噪声来隐藏后门触发器，严重挑战了计算智能模型的鲁棒性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了NADAFD——一种噪声感知与动态自适应的联邦防御框架，该框架集成了频域分析、空域分析和客户端行为分析，以应对此类攻击。
tldr: 提出了一种噪声感知与动态自适应的联邦防御框架NADAFD，通过融合频域、空域与客户端行为分析，有效抵御恶意客户端利用SAR散斑噪声隐藏后门触发器的联邦学习攻击。
